title: Specified K-flat tensor comparison under the section equivalence
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $T$ use its small pro-étale site, small relative to module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the pulled-back ring object $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and its reconstructed section-ring sheaf, and the fixed exact internal/section module equivalence $E_T$ [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use the ordinary operations and universe convention of [def-pd-section-module-operations-data]. Let $q_T^{\mathrm i},q_T^{\mathrm s}$ denote the internal and section homotopy-to-derived localizations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and write $\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm i},\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm s}$ for the full subcategories of K-flat complexes with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], with the corresponding exact-tensor and acyclic-total-tensor tests internally. All total tensors below are signed direct-sum cochain totals [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and all derived tensors are relative to $R_T$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Use the fixed conjugate section tensor, equivalence localization factors and ordinary total comparison of [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data], and the section tensor localization map of [def-pd-section-derived-realization]. Write $D(E_T)$ for the fixed localized equivalence and $\kappa_P:D(E_T)q_T^{\mathrm i}P\cong q_T^{\mathrm s}E_TP$ for its factor. Then termwise $E_T$ preserves and reflects quasi-isomorphisms and identifies $\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm i}$ with $\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm s}$. The internal representative subcategory localizes equivalently onto the internal derived category; restriction to its resolving pairs is fully faithful for natural transformations with arbitrary target category. The prescribed conjugate section tensor is identified with the independently constructed ringed K-flat tensor of [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent], including its localization map. More precisely there is a unique natural isomorphism
$$\theta_{T;M,N}:D(E_T)(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_T}N)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(E_T)M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_T}D(E_T)N$$
whose representative normalization is
$$ (\kappa_P\otimes^{\mathbf L}\kappa_Q)\,\theta_{T;q_T^{\mathrm i}P,q_T^{\mathrm i}Q}\,D(E_T)(r^{\mathrm i}_{P,Q})=r^{\mathrm s}_{E_TP,E_TQ}\,q_T^{\mathrm s}(t_{P,Q})\,\kappa_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)}.$$
Here $P,Q\in\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm i}$, $r^{\mathrm i},r^{\mathrm s}$ are the fixed isomorphisms from localized total tensor to derived tensor, and $t_{P,Q}:E_T\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(E_TP\otimes E_TQ)$ is the ordinary total comparison. This is the fixed conjugate comparison, not an independently chosen isomorphism. The regular module in degree zero is a flat-term K-flat representative. Localizing the specified ordinary regular-module comparison gives an isomorphism $e_T:D(E_T)(R_T[0])\cong R_{T,\mathrm{sec}}[0]$. With the internal constraints induced from complexes and the fixed section constraints of [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data], $\theta_T,e_T$ satisfy the derived associator and both unitor diagrams on every pair or triple of derived objects. These claims retain independent site object and morphism universes and all unbounded complexes.

proof.text: Restrict qTensor to flat-term K-flat cochain pairs; tensor_representatives makes this restriction invertible. Let r be the canonical representative comparison of cochain_tensor_model_rigidity. Resolving-pair full faithfulness lifts qTensor followed by r to an isomorphism v from the prescribed conjugate tensor to the independent tensor. Define the native localization map q as v inverse followed by qTensor on every complex pair. On resolving pairs r is exactly tensorDescentPair; the lifted equation and cancellation give tensorDescentPair followed by q equals identity. Thus q has precisely the native normalization and v identifies the localization maps on every complex pair.

proof.text: The monoidal unit is categorically flat, and the proved kFlat_single_obj_iff_flat makes its degree-zero single complex K-flat. Its other terms are zero and hence flat. proof.text: For any equivalence E use the induced monoidal structure on its inverse into the transported monoidal category. The left adjoint oplax monoidal structure has unit identity and tensor maps E(unit_M tensor unit_N), by the equivalence triangle identities. The uniqueness specification tensorComparison_existsUnique identifies these maps with tensorComparison. The oplax structure supplies the associator and both unitor diagrams required by ConstraintCondition.
